integrity: An explicit all-parameter mathematical proof and reproducible finite diagnostics are supplied. Finite diagnostics are not universal proofs. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only degree-one complex Lagrange interpolation using exactly two distinct samples on a proper closed circular arc; does not optimize all projections or nonlinear sampling algorithms. Priority against earlier complex-arc interpolation literature is subject to independent evaluation.
title: Sharp two-point Lebesgue constants and inward optimal nodes on circular arcs
